summary: Rio Tinto filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 production results. The filing discloses operational metrics such as a 3% year-over-year increase in copper equivalent production, record iron ore output, and progress at the Simandou project. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—is announced. The filing is a routine periodic earnings release by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a U.S. quarterly earnings press release, and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
